content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Presets stripe

Let's take a closer look at what each of these options actually offers. Stripe operates in 46 countries worldwide, but if you're in a restricted country, you're out of luck. Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy are no better, with limited countries and strict requirements. PayPal is a bit more flexible, but its account suspension policy leaves much to be desired. Meanwhile, Edge Commerce Stack ($197) provides a comprehensive solution with [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/cloudflare-r2-digital-product-storage-delivery-what-actually-6|Cloudflare R2]] Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments, deployed in 48 hours, with no country restrictions and no account suspension risks.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

When it comes to restricted countries, Stripe, Gumroad, and Lemon Squeezy all have one thing in common: they're unavailable. PayPal, on the other hand, may allow transactions from restricted countries, but you're still at risk of account suspension and frozen funds. Edge Commerce Stack, however, is designed to work anywhere, with no country restrictions and no reliance on third-party payment processors.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Payment speed, fees, and real costs are all crucial considerations when choosing a commerce infrastructure solution. Stripe, Gumroad, and Lemon Squeezy all charge high fees and have slow payment processing times. PayPal's fees are a bit more competitive, but its account suspension policy can still leave you with significant costs. Edge Commerce Stack, on the other hand, offers fast payment processing, low fees, and no account suspension risks.
Edge Commerce Stack is designed to break free from outdated infrastructure choices and build a sovereign commerce stack that truly belongs to you.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

When it comes to ownership, automation, and delivery, Edge Commerce Stack stands out from the crowd. With Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and Supabase, you have full control over your commerce stack, with no reliance on third-party services. NOWPayments handles automatic on-chain crypto payment verification, with no fees for failed payments. Meanwhile, your customers get instant access to their purchases, without having to wait for payments to clear.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

So, which architecture should you choose based on your situation? If you're in a restricted country, Edge Commerce Stack is the clear winner. If you're looking for a solution that's fast, flexible, and cost-effective, Edge Commerce Stack is still the best choice. And if you want to break free from outdated infrastructure choices and build a sovereign commerce stack that truly belongs to you, Edge Commerce Stack is the only option.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

The direct answer is NOWPayments combined with a sovereign commerce stack. NOWPayments is a crypto payment processor that requires no KYC from merchants and no account creation from buyers. It supports over 300 coins, charges 0.5% per transaction, and sends a webhook to your backend the moment payment confirms on-chain. Your backend — a Cloudflare Worker in Stack 02, a Google Apps Script Web App in Stack 01 — receives the webhook, verifies the transaction hash on the blockchain, logs the order, generates a receipt, and sends the delivery email automatically. There is no platform that can suspend your access, no compliance team that can flag your account, no payout schedule that delays your revenue, and no company that can change the rules on you tomorrow.
Edge Commerce Stack offers fast payment processing, low fees, and no account suspension risks, making it the perfect choice for digital creators in restricted countries.

Your Deployment Checklist

Accept that no workaround inside conventional payment infrastructure is durable — platforms actively close gaps as they discover them. Create a NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as your starting point — these cover the widest range of buyers in restricted markets. Choose your stack: Stack 01 for a self-deployed free setup using GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script, Stack 02 for the Edge Stack deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours. Configure the NOWPayments webhook endpoint URL in your IPN settings pointing to your backend. Upload your product files to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/complete-deep-dive-how-bangladeshi-freelancers-accept-international-2|COREMERCH guide to complete]] a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the full pipeline: webhook received, transaction verified on-chain, order logged, delivery email sent, download link working. Share your store URL only after the mainnet test passes cleanly.
